name: kumiho-memory-cloud
description: Persistent memory for Claude across conversations. Recall and save decisions, preferences and facts in your private Kumiho workspace, review stored memories, and import reviewed memories from selected past conversations. Connect via /mcp (Cowork: Connect) after installing. Bundles the hosted Kumiho Memory MCP connector (OAuth) and six skills. Start a 14-day free trial with Google, no card required, or connect a paid Kumiho Cloud workspace.
